plot_xyz_1d: plot three colored lines (red, green, blue) on a matplotlib axis from numpy arrays
set_equal_aspect_ratio_2D: set equal aspect ratio and symmetric limits on a 2D matplotlib axis
set_equal_aspect_ratio_3D: set equal aspect ratio and symmetric limits on a 3D matplotlib axis
draw_3d_axes_quiver: draw 3D coordinate axes with colored quiver arrows on a matplotlib 3D plot
draw_3d_axes_trajectory: draw 3D camera trajectory axes using a world-to-camera transformation matrix
